# ASSUMED Antigravity (`agy`) `/model` menu layout — NOT VERIFIED.
#
# `agy` is not installed on any dev machine reachable to the project, so the
# real rendering of the interactive `/model` menu (header wording, the
# "current" selection glyph, and whether model ids carry a vendor prefix) has
# never been captured. This file is a SYNTHETIC stand-in that pins the shape
# `parse_antigravity` currently assumes, so the heuristic parser has an
# explicit, reviewable fixture instead of an inline string buried in a test.
#
# Layout assumed here (mirrors the verified `parse_codex` / `parse_claude`
# captures):
#   * a header line containing "Select model" anchors extraction,
#   * each model is a numbered row ("  1. <id> ..."),
#   * the model id is the first whitespace-delimited token of the row,
#   * the active model is flagged with a trailing "(current)" marker
#     (the parser also treats the √ and ● glyphs as "current").
#
# Lines starting with '#' are fixture comments and are stripped before the
# bytes are handed to the parser (real PTY output never contains them).
#
# TODO(agy-verify): replace this synthetic fixture with a real PTY capture
# (`testdata/models_antigravity.bin`, like the other agents) once `agy` is
